title: AI Supply Index
subtitle: Who is actually earning in the AI economy?
description:
A weekly, timestamped, independently collected record of the supply side of the AI economy.

Most public measurement covers demand — how many people use AI, for what. The supply side (who is actually earning, and how concentrated those earnings are) is measured far less often, and several of the sources that would answer it do not keep history. A snapshot not taken this week cannot be reconstructed later.

Method, schema, known limits, conflict of interest and how to cite: https://github.com/mergenhq/ai-supply-index
